name: Enterprise Finance + HR — End-to-End Planning
description: Workspace task flow for the Enterprise Finance + HR solution. Shows the logical flow from ingestion to governed planning analytics. The Data Pipeline 'Enterprise Finance HR Aggregate Refresh' is the execution orchestrator; task-flow connectors show logical flow only, not data movement.

tasks.name: Orchestrate aggregate refresh
tasks.description: Data Pipeline that runs the end-to-end refresh: load Delta tables, refresh the five aggregate Dataflows Gen2, then run the aggregate quality gate. This is the solution orchestrator.

tasks.name: Ingest planning data
tasks.description: Streams planning exceptions and loads synthetic Finance + HR CSV sources into Delta tables.

tasks.name: Store enterprise data
tasks.description: Lakehouse holds the aggregate Delta source and bi_* tables; Eventhouse/KQL stores planning telemetry for real-time analytics.

tasks.name: Prepare aggregate measures
tasks.description: Five Dataflows Gen2 build aggregate-only compensation, attendance, absence, recruitment, and curated finance tables. No employee-level records are surfaced.

tasks.name: Aggregate quality gate
tasks.description: Notebook that validates non-empty sources, rejects negative compensation/hours, and enforces small-group suppression before analytics is published.

tasks.name: Model ontology and semantics
tasks.description: Ontology, graph model, graph queries, native Fabric Plan, and the Direct Lake semantic model expose governed planning entities and measures.

tasks.name: Visualize planning
tasks.description: Real-time KQL dashboard and the Northstar Finance + HR planning app present aggregate spend, capacity, absence, and recruitment signals.

tasks.name: Operational agents
tasks.description: Data Agent and Operations Agent answer governed, aggregate-only planning questions across the lakehouse and KQL data.
